reviewer: Codex, independent; did not author v2, v3, v4, v5, v6, v7, or v8
reviewScope: Independent design-contract review only. This review does not mark DR-103 SATISFIED, does not qualify or demonstrate anything, and does not authorize implementation.
summary: The v7-to-v8 delta is closed and the lock, custody, authority, and predecessor-finding attacks are clean. The claimed V7-A1 repair is not digest-complete, however: the v2 fixture-corpus candidate has no digest, and the v1 candidate digest does not establish the separately asserted independent-review outcome. That contradicts v8's own EIR discipline and leaves one SHOULD-FIX.

shouldFix.title: The claimed digest-cited fixture repair leaves the v2 candidate unpinned and the v1 review outcome uncited
shouldFix.detail: The purpose asserts that every empirical claim is measured or cited at digest, the dispatch describes V7-A1 as repairing the fixture-corpus references by citing the candidates at digest, and repairLog[52] claims a measured non-binding citation. /whatThisDoesNotDo/1 does pin component-manifest-fixture-corpus.v1.json at d81a4ef9ed26405a07e84ae0be9a3d2048fd9a6126b1f93d139a5a499204b542, but it names component-manifest-fixture-corpus.v2.json only as a draft and supplies no digest. I measured the present v2 candidate as e2781f449599909c7b2bfc8d827591911323f8633e2b5f419fcb27e772e6c9da. The same sentence calls v1 'independently REJECTED', but the adjacent d81a... pin identifies the candidate bytes, not any verdict bytes; the candidate at that digest still records reviewStatus AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW. A later verdict may establish the outcome, but v8 cites no verdict digest, so that empirical status cannot be resolved from the claimed citation.
shouldFix.whyItMatters: Both candidates exist and remain non-binding, so this is not a false existence claim or an authorization defect. It is still a current contract inconsistency: a draft path can move, and a candidate-subject digest cannot authenticate a review disposition. A reviewer following the promised digest trail cannot reproduce the full sentence.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: In a successor, add the full measured digest for component-manifest-fixture-corpus.v2.json. Either cite the exact independent-verdict digest that establishes v1's REJECT disposition or replace that disposition with the digest-supported candidate standing. Preserve the explicit not-accepted, not-qualified, not-applied, and not-DR-103-SATISFIED boundary.

advisories.title: OD-V8-1 introduces a second top-level open-decision registry beside namedOpenDecisions
advisories.detail: V7-A2 pointed to the existing OD-1 pattern. V8 makes the carried Claude V6-A2/A3 decision findable and owned, but adds it under /openDecisions while /namedOpenDecisions remains the registry containing OD-1. No distinction between the two arrays is declared. A later successor should merge OD-V8-1 into namedOpenDecisions or state the intended difference between the registries.
advisories.notBlocking: OD-V8-1 has an id, decision, owner, standing, source finding ids, and a matching reference in appliesFindingsOf.notFoldedThisSuccessor; the carried advisories are therefore recoverable and the requested ownership defect is substantively repaired.

attackListDisposition.attack: Any still-producible lock, including exact-pin, constrained, requirement, and rejection-rule sites
attackListDisposition.detail: lockSchema.purpose, both resolutionInputs request forms, resolutionInputs.semantics, and ID-DEP-4 all forbid producing any lock until DR-111 closes. TC-ACCEPT defers its lock member, TC-SIG and TC-BYTE-EXACT gate lock-bearing fixtures on DR-111, and RJ-4 marks its lock-digest arm inactive. The live register still records DR-111 OPEN.

attackListDisposition.attack: Calling an exact-pin custody copy a lock
attackListDisposition.detail: resolutionInputs.semantics and ID-DEP-4 both say that a non-validating exact-pin custody copy is not a lock.

attackListDisposition.detail: Both named candidates exist at the stated paths and both identify themselves as CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED / binds NOTHING. The defect is the incomplete and misattached digest trail in V8-S1, not the existence or non-acceptance statement.
The closed roster V7-B1, V7-S1, V7-A1, V7-A2, META-v8 matches repairLog[50:55] exactly, with no future-fold hedge.

The header remains DESIGN-CONTRACT-CANDIDATE / CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED / AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW / DO-NOT-SEAL / binds NOTHING with authorityClaim NONE. The fixture sentence denies acceptance, qualification, application, and DR-103 satisfaction; this review grants none of them.

attackListDisposition.detail: Codex v7 contains blocker V7-B1 and no other finding; Claude 2 v7 contains SHOULD-FIX V7-S1 and advisories V7-A1 and V7-A2. appliesFindingsOf and repairLog reproduce that set exactly; META-v8 is explicitly authoring metadata.

The fixture-citation advisory is only partially landed, as V8-S1 describes. The owner/open-decision part of V7-A2 is landed, with the registry-shape advisory V8-A1.
